import React from 'react'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import './Sidebar.css'; function Sidebar() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const userName = localStorage.getItem('userName'); const handleLogout = () => { localStorage.clear(); navigate('/login'); }; return (
{userName ? userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U'}
{userName || 'User'} @{userName || 'user'}
); } export default Sidebar;
